mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.5% for three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate consumer demand contraction, lowering corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 signals manufacturing supply contraction, reducing corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105, or Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Positive payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 100k per month supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is always active during labor market expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeding 2.5% signals rising inflation, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1200k units signal housing market recovery, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal active monetary tightening, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increase, or interaction Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
